title: Validation of the German version of the International Trauma Questionnaire including clinical checks (ITQcc) in a clinical sample in Medical Psychology at the BG Klinikum Bergmannstrost Halle
summary: This study aims to validate a new questionnaire (ITQcc) measuring PTSD symptoms according to ICD-11 criteria. It investigates whether additional clinical checks improve diagnostic accuracy in clinical settings.
conditions: The target population for this validation study consists of patients who present at the Department of Medical Psychology at BG Klinikum Bergmannstrost Halle or who are receiving outpatient or inpatient psychotherapeutic treatment there. This population regularly experiences workplace or commuting accidents, which are often accompanied by severe physical injuries and subsequent psychological distress.

interventions.name: Once participants have been informed and have provided written consent, data collection takes place digitally via a closed Lamapoll survey. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Minimum age of 18
- Sufficient knowledge of German (to complete the questionnaires)
- History of a traumatic event (ICD Criterion A occurring more than 4 weeks ago)
Exclusion criteria:
- Severe mental disorders that impair the ability to give informed consent (e.g., psychoses)
- Severe cognitive impairments (e.g., dementia, traumatic brain injury)
- Acute suicidal ideation
